page.layout: One column of index entries in italic, each with its page number at the right edge of the column, the numbers partly cut off by the scan edge. No running head, page number, catchword or signature in this part.; One page of text in a single column, set in italic lines; a large letter at the top right; a short line "40" beside the top entries; a centred heading "HISPANICA" with "Lusitanica" below; the remaining lines are in one column.; One page of index in two columns of entries with page numbers at the right; the first heading "Index." is cut off at the top of this part. Below the list: a line "FINIS" spaced out, then a printer's ornament. Entries run in three groups: left column of page numbers, centre column of entries with headings "GALLICA", right column of page numbers.; One column of table entries, with page numbers at the right; no running head, no page number visible on this part.
page.notes: The large letter at the top is partly cut off. The marginal "40" beside the first entries is printed at the right edge. Several entries at the left edge are partly cropped. Left and right edges are cut; the left-hand column of numbers and the first words of the left entries are partly lost. Several numbers in the right column are doubtful (e.g. "28.72", "38"). The ornament below FINIS is a woodcut, not text. The first entries are partly faint; "Slaa" and "Snock" are read as printed. The numbers "23" and "59.b" are doubtful in places.
